title: Astra Horizon dialogue busts (emerald-monster cast)
note: User-approved spec (2026-10-25 「이거는 꽤 규격이 괜찮네. 앞으로 이렇게 하도록 하네싱을 꽉 잡도록」). Every new Astra cast bust goes through this.

pipeline.engine: char-gen `command` image engine -> private codex image route (scripts/content/monsters/astra_professor_chargen/kaykai_cmd.py)
pipeline.baker: scripts/content/monsters/bake_astra_busts64.py (native grid recovery -> 64x64 place -> face-only expression edits -> one shared 16-colour palette)

variants.nat: Draw it as a REAL low-resolution pixel-art sprite: the whole square picture is a grid of exactly 48 x 48 art pixels, each art pixel a solid flat square of one colour about 21 screen pixels wide (no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering, no texture, no sub-pixel detail). At this tiny size every feature is placed pixel by pixel like a Game Boy Advance dialogue portrait: each eye about 4 art pixels wide and 5 tall (dark lash row on top, coloured iris, one white highlight pixel, a white pixel at the outer corner), eyebrows 3-4 pixels, the mouth 3-4 pixels, the nose one shadow pixel, a 1-pixel dark outline around the silhouette. The head (hair top to chin) is about 36 art pixels tall and fills the frame; shoulders run off the bottom edge.
variants.sml: Draw it as a REAL low-resolution pixel-art sprite: the whole square picture is a grid of exactly 40 x 40 art pixels, each art pixel a solid flat square of one colour about 26 screen pixels wide (no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering, no texture, no sub-pixel detail). At this tiny size every feature is placed pixel by pixel like a Game Boy Advance dialogue portrait: each eye about 4 art pixels wide and 5 tall (dark lash row on top, coloured iris, one white highlight pixel, a white pixel at the outer corner), eyebrows 3-4 pixels, the mouth 3-4 pixels, the nose one shadow pixel, a 1-pixel dark outline around the silhouette. The whole head INCLUDING all of the hair fits inside the picture with a 1-pixel margin at the top and sides; the head is about 30 art pixels tall; the collar and the top of the shoulders show at the bottom.

pipeline.expressionTemplate:
Edit the attached pixel-art dialogue portrait. Return the SAME picture: identical square size, identical pixel grid (same art-pixel size), identical framing and position, identical hair, clothes, colours and the same flat magenta #FF00FF background. Change ONLY the facial expression - the eyebrows, the eyes and the mouth - to: {expression}.
Keep the same clean, friendly Game Boy Advance style: each feature drawn with a few solid square pixels, no extra lines, no shading noise, no tears, no sweat drops, no symbols, no text.

expressionPrompts.happy: HAPPY: a big cheerful smile with the mouth open (a small open D-shaped mouth showing a little red inside), the eyes closed into happy upward arcs (^ ^), eyebrows raised and relaxed, a light blush on the cheeks
expressionPrompts.sad: SAD: eyebrows slanted up toward the middle of the forehead, the eyes half-lidded and looking a little down, the mouth a small downturned frown
expressionPrompts.angry: ANGRY / DETERMINED: eyebrows slanted sharply down toward the nose, narrowed eyes with the iris still visible, the mouth a tense frown, set jaw
expressionPrompts.surprised: SURPRISED: eyebrows raised high, the eyes wide open and round with small pupils and more white showing, the mouth a small open round "O"
expressionPrompts.serious: SERIOUS: flat straight eyebrows lowered slightly, calm steady eyes, the mouth a short firm straight line (not smiling)

castLines.nurse: 어서 오세요! 몬스터를 쉬게 해 드릴게요.
castLines.naru: 나도 오늘 첫 동료를 받았어. 승부하자!

professor.name: 천문박사
professor.identity: the professor, a kind, gentle scientist about 50 years old, clean-shaven (NO beard, NO stubble, NO moustache), NO glasses. Medium brown hair in a few big soft messy locks with one small cowlick on top, light grey hair at both temples, blue eyes, a warm calm smile, one or two tiny smile-line pixels at the outer eye corners (that is the only sign of age; no wrinkles elsewhere). White lab coat with wide lapels over a dark navy shirt, a small gold star badge on the chest. He must read clearly as a middle-aged father figure, older than the mother in the reference, never as a teenager: a slightly longer face and a squarer jaw than the young characters, eyes a little narrower and calmer (iris 3 pixels tall, not 5), thicker straight eyebrows, the grey at the temples clearly visible, a relaxed gentle closed-mouth smile.

lines.angry: 그건 안 된다. 별을 함부로 다루면 안 돼.
